blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — A day after organizers of an annual Halloween parade was forced to shutdown this year’s plans due to a religious backlash, an online petition began circulating on Tuesday (Sept. 22), demanding the repeal of Baguio’s Creative City status for suppressing creativity. A group of young professionals had informed the Baguio City Council on Monday (Sept. 21) that they would hold a tamer “Fantasy Parade” in place of the yearly Halloween costume parade to ease tensions with the Diocese of Baguio, as well as with an evangelical group that questioned City Hall for backing events that it says promotes […]...
